decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. We are adding a $10 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. If you need it, you can get a zero-interest advance of up to $500, repaid from your next deposit.
